name: Exage 500LX triple crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 756 g for the exact unsuffixed FC-M500, 170 mm and 48/38/28T, excluding the separately listed bottom-bracket set. The later -SG model code is retained separately; no equivalence is asserted. The weighed ring profile is not specified.
